Madhya Pradesh to Host Passenger Mobility Summit in Indore

Madhya Pradesh will host the Yatri Parivahan Vision Summit 2026 in Indore on September 11-12. The summit aims to chart a new path for passenger mobility, focusing on transitioning from comfort to sustainability. The event is intended to explore advancements and strategies in passenger transportation.
